hero.subtitle: I build **end-to-end ML pipelines** turning messy, imbalanced, real-world data into models. Currently hunting for a **data science / ML internship**.

bio: I got into data science by being **wrong a lot** my first models looked perfect until **data leakage** humbled me. Now I chase the questions most people skip: where did this data come from, and is this number lying to me? So I **test before I trust**: feature engineering, clean pipelines, statistical testing, cross-validation, model selection, and honest evaluation over raw accuracy.
I like the **unglamorous 80%** cleaning, EDA, doubting as much as the modelling.
